name: novachat-enterprise-platform
description: World-class Real-Time HD Video Chat Platform with Next.js, Express, Prisma, Socket.io, WebRTC & AI Moderation

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "cd backend && npm run start" "cd frontend && npm run start"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install

author: NovaChat Team
